sourceFacts.fact: Phototherapy converts unconjugated bilirubin into photoisomers that can be excreted without the usual conjugation step.
Blue light acts on bilirubin; it does not directly remove a drawn organ blockage.

labels: Phototherapy changes bilirubin into excretable forms
